sources.title: ReproZip packing experiments
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。

related.title: Extra-P：可辨識模型與外推保留樣本
related.titleEn: Extra-P: identifiable performance models and held-out extrapolation
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：接手者能指出仍缺哪一項及為何；不能把封裝命令成功當成整個實驗已可重現。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The receiver identifies the remaining dependency and its consequence; successful archive creation is not accepted as proof of a reproduced experiment.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「Extra-P：可辨識模型與外推保留樣本」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付參數表、三項貢獻圖、保留樣本預測與殘差；記錄擬合、選模、驗證三個資料角色及可外推範圍。
related.differenceEn: Investigate Extra-P: identifiable performance models and held-out extrapolation using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver parameter definitions, term-by-term contributions, frozen held-out predictions and residuals. Distinguish fitting, selection and validation roles, and state the range over which the evidence supports a prediction.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 為27個已封裝檔建立ID、路徑、大小、hash四欄；加入一個同名不同hash與一個不同路徑同內容別名，分別檢查錯誤接受與重複計數。
在n=8逐列計算2、4、6秒，再於n=16計算2、8、16秒；將log2的輸入標為無因次，避免對帶秒的量直接取對數。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Create ID, path, size and hash columns for the twenty-seven packaged matches. Add a same-name hash mismatch and a different-path alias of identical content to challenge both false acceptance and accidental double counting.

Build a worksheet showing contributions 2, 4 and 6 seconds at n=8 and 2, 8 and 16 at n=16. Explicitly mark the logarithm argument as dimensionless rather than taking a logarithm of a dimensional duration.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Aurora：GPU tile 的 CPU 集合與隔離證明
related.titleEn: Aurora: CPU-set isolation for GPU tile processes
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：接手者能指出仍缺哪一項及為何；不能把封裝命令成功當成整個實驗已可重現。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The receiver identifies the remaining dependency and its consequence; successful archive creation is not accepted as proof of a reproduced experiment.
related.difference: 輸入 tile、rank、cpu_ids 的 JSON；展開範圍後排序，產生聯集、重複使用者與空集合三個輸出。
related.differenceEn: Parse a JSON list of tile, rank and cpu_ids fields. Expand ranges before sorting, and emit the union, a reverse owner map and the list of empty sets as three separately inspectable artifacts.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 為27個已封裝檔建立ID、路徑、大小、hash四欄；加入一個同名不同hash與一個不同路徑同內容別名，分別檢查錯誤接受與重複計數。

每個 rank 的 CPU 集合需與其他隔離集合不相交；總需求為集合聯集的基數，不能把字串長度當處理器數；教學配置 12 個 tile 程序，每個使用 4 個不同 CPU；變更為 8 個程序。CPU 編號允許不連續，且不是 Aurora 實際綁定表；名義式 12*4 = 48 CPU identifiers；變更式 8*4 = 32 CPU identifiers。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Create ID, path, size and hash columns for the twenty-seven packaged matches. Add a same-name hash mismatch and a different-path alias of identical content to challenge both false acceptance and accidental double counting.

Isolation is a pairwise-disjointness condition. Capacity is the cardinality of the union of allowed CPU identifiers; string length, maximum CPU number and summed set sizes are different quantities. Use twelve synthetic tile processes with four distinct CPU identifiers each, then eight processes. Identifiers may have gaps. These are teaching sets, not the production Aurora binding table or a claim about enabled hardware. Nominal 12*4 = 48 CPU identifiers; changed 8*4 = 32 CPU identifiers. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
